# JobProof

> Find jobs. Verify jobs. Apply directly.

JobProof is an AI-powered job discovery, verification, and direct-application platform built to eliminate job scams, ghost listings, expired posts, and fake salary estimates.

## Platform APIs
- [/api/jobs](http://localhost:5173/api/jobs): Authenticated live job listings with multi-point authenticity scores.
- [/api/health](http://localhost:5173/api/health): Service uptime and operational telemetry endpoint.

## Key Capabilities
- Direct ATS Ingestion: Integrates with Greenhouse, Lever, Workday, and official employer career portals.
- 5-Tier Verification Engine: Verifies source truth, SSL status, active requisition codes, and salary transparency.
- AI Resume Compatibility Analyzer: Analyzes candidate skills against requirements with zero recruiter middlemen.
